[RSS 2024]: Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots

Expressive Whole-Body Control for Humanoid Robots Xuxin Cheng* · Yandong Ji* · Junming Chen Ge Yang · Xiaolong Wang Website | arXiv | Video | Summary ## Installation ## Next install fbx. Follow the instructions [here](https://github.com/nv-tlabs/ASE/issues/61). ## Prepare dataset 1. Download from [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1m3JRBox51cjV4CbiKIcVXR6eKQBjaAhO/view?usp=sharing) and extract the zip file to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/cmu_fbx_all` that contains all `.fbx` files. 2. Gnerate `.yaml` file for the motions you want to use. This step is not mandatory because the `.yaml` file is already generated. But if you want to add more motions, you can use this script to generate the `.yaml` file. 3. Import motions This will import all motions in CMU Mocap dataset into `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy`. 4. Retarget motions This will retarget all motions in `ASE/ase/poselib/data/npy` to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. 5. Gnerate keybody positions This step will require running simulation to extract more precise key body positions. Train for 1 iteration and kill the program to have a dummy model to load. It is recommended to use `motions_autogen_all.yaml` at the first time, so that later if you have a subset it is not neccessary to regenerate keybody positions. This will generate keybody positions to `ASE/ase/poselib/data/retarget_npy`. Set wandb asset: ## Usage To train a new policy `xxx-xx` is usually an id like `000-01`. `motion_type` and `motion_name` are defined in `legged_gym/legged_gym/envs/h1/h1_mimic_config.py`. They can be also given as arguments. Can set default WANDB_ENTITY in `legged_gym/legged_gym/utils/helpers.py`. To play a policy No need to write the full experimentt id. The parser will auto match runs with first 6 strings (xxx-xx). So better make sure you don't reuse xxx-xx. Delay is added after 8k iters. If you want to play after 8k, add `--delay`. >[!abstract] 一句话总结：基于CMU MoCap动作捕捉数据，通过强化学习训练全身控制策略，并利用仿真提取关键身体部位位置，实现从动作数据到人形机器人全身控制策略的迁移与部署。


# 一、动机

> 现有的人形机器人控制方法通常仅关注行走或操作任务，缺乏全身协调和表达性动作生成能力，难以表现丰富自然的人体动作。该论文旨在通过模仿学习实现人形机器人的全身控制，以支持多样化、具表现力的行为。


# 二、方法

> 基于CMU MoCap动作捕捉数据，通过强化学习训练全身控制策略，并利用仿真提取关键身体部位位置，实现从动作数据到人形机器人全身控制策略的迁移与部署。


# 三、核心实验结果

> 论文中未在摘要提供具体数字，但展示了所提方法能够在仿真中模仿多种人体动作，并将策略迁移到真实人形机器人上执行全身协调的肢体动作。


# 四、对我的启发

> 局限包括对大规模动作捕捉数据的依赖，以及仿真到真实环境的迁移仍需关键点校正；启发是全身控制可通过参考动作+强化学习实现，而不需要显式设计运动基元。
